chapter.verse: Tu-in Pharisee mi Nicodemus a kici Jew ulian khat om hi.

Hih mipa zan hunin Jesu' kiangah pai a, “Rabbi aw, nang pen Pasian' kiangpan hong pai hilhcian sya khat na hihlam ka thei uh hi. A hang pen hih na bawl kihilna limte Pasian' ompih lohin kuamah in bawl thei lo ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah mi khatpeuh suakkik lo pi-in Pasian' kumpigam mu theilo ding hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Nicodemus in, “Mi khat a teek nungah bangci bangin suakkik thei ding ahi hiam? A nu' naubu sungah a nihveina lutin suakkik thei ding ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah mi khatpeuh tui leh Kha tawh a suah keileh Pasian' kumpigam lut theilo ding hi.
Cilesa tawh a suakte cilesa hi a, Kha tawh a suakte kha ahi hi.
‘Na suahkik uh kul hi,’ kong cih ciangin lamdang sa kei in.
Huih pen a utna peuh ah nung a, a huging na zak hangin koi pan hong pai-a koi lam manawh cih na thei kei hi. Kha tawh a suakte zong tua bang mah ahi hi.”
Nicodemus in, “Hih thute bangci piantheih ding ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Israel mite' hilhcian sya hinapi-in hih thute tel lo na hi hiam?
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah kote in ka theih uh genin ka muh khitsa uh teci ka pang uh a, ahi zongin ka teci panna uh na sang kei uh hi.
Leitung thute kong gen ciangin um lo na hihleh vantung thute hong gen le-ing bangci up theih ding na hi hiam?
Vantung pan hong kumsuk ahi Mihing' Tapa losiah vantung a kahto kuamah om lo hi.
Tua hi a, gamgawtak lakah Moses in gul a khaitoh mah bangin Mihing' Tapa zong a kikhaitoh kul hi.
Amah a um peuhpeuh tawntung nuntakna a ngah theih nading ahi hi.
“A hang pen Pasian in leitung mite hong it mahmah ahih manin ama' Tapa a um peuhpeuh si lo-in tawntung nuntakna a ngah theih nadingin khat bek ahi ama' Tapa hong piakhia hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian in a Tapa leitung hong sawlna pen mawhsak thukhenna a pia ding hilo-in leitung mite in Tapa' tungtawnin hotkhiat a ngah theih nading hizaw hi.
Tapa a um peuhpeuh mawhsak thukhenna thuak lo hi. Ahih hangin a um lo peuhpeuh pen khat bek ahi Pasian' Tapa' min a up loh manin mawhsak thukhenna a thuak hita hi.
Tua hi a, thukhenna thu hih bang ahi hi: leitung ah khuavak hong tung khin napi, mite a gamtat uh siahuai ahih manin khuavak sangin khuamial ngaizaw uh hi.
A hang pen a tatsia mi khempeuh in khuavak hua uh a, a gamtatna uh kilangkha leh ci-in khuavak zuan lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin thumaanin a gamta mi peuhpeuh in a sepkhiatte uh Pasian' zia bangin kisemkhia ahihlam teltak a kimuh nadingin khuavak zuan uh hi.”
Tua nungah Jesu leh a nungzuite Judea gam khuatalam ah pai uh a, Jesu zong tua takah amaute tawh taamin mite baptize hi.
John zong Salim geinai Aenon ah mite baptize hi. A hang pen tua mun ah tui tampi om hi. Mite zong hong pai-in baptizena sang uh hi.
(A hang pen tua hunin John thong sung kikhia nailo hi).
Tua laitak John' nungzuite kimkhat leh Jew mi khat kikal ah siansuahna vai-in thu a maanzaw kituhna khat piang hi.
Tua hangin amaute John' kiang pai uh a, “Rabbi aw, Jordan galkhat ah nang tawh a omkhawm mipa, a thu teci na pan mipa, en dih in! Amah in mite baptize a, mi khempeuh in amah zuan uh hi,” ci uh hi.
John in, “Vantung pan a kipiak kei nakleh kuamah in na khat nangawn ngah theilo hi.
‘Khris ka hikei a, ama' ma-a hong kisawlkholpa ka hi hi,’ ci-in ka gen pen note mahmah ka teci na hi uh hi.

Mo nungak pen zipi tangvalpa' ading ahi hi. Zipi tangvalpa' gei-ah dingin zipi tangvalpa' pau ngai-a a om a lawmpa pen zipi tangvalpa' awging a zak ciangin nakpi-in nuam hi. Tua hi a, hih keima' nuamna pen tu-in kicing hi.
Amah khang ding a, kei ka hihleh ka kiam ding hi,” ci hi.
Tunglam pan hong pai mipa pen vekpi sangin lianzaw hi. Leitung pana piang mipa leitung lama om hi a, leitungvai takin pau hi. Vantung pan hong pai mipa pen vekpi sangin lianzaw hi.
Amah in a muhsa leh a zaksa thute teci pang a, ahih hangin kuamah in ama' teci panna sang lo hi.
Ama' teci panna a sang peuhpeuh, Pasian thumaan hi ci-in ciaptehna gip a belh ahi hi.
A hang pen Pasian in ama' sawl mipa' tungah ciangtan nei lo-in Kha pia ahih manin ama' sawl mipa in Pasian' thu mah pulak hi.
Pa in Tapa it a, na khempeuh ama' khut sungah pia khin hi.
Tapa a um peuhpeuh in tawntung nuntakna nei a, Tapa' thu a mang lo peuhpeuh in nuntakna mu lo-in ama' tungah Pasian' hehna thaamsuak hi.
